name: cjlludwig.github.io
description: Professional portfolio website for Connor Ludwig - Senior Staff Software Engineer
author: Connor Ludwig

scripts.generate-resume-pdf: pandoc resume.md -o public/resume.pdf --pdf-engine=xelatex -V geometry:margin=0.75in -V linkcolor:blue -V urlcolor:blue || echo 'Warning: PDF generation skipped (pandoc not installed)'
scripts.generate-resume: npm run parse-resume && npm run generate-resume-pdf
scripts.dev: npm run parse-resume && npm run fix-blogs && npm run generate-blogs && npm run cache-github-stats && vite
scripts.build: npm run parse-resume && npm run generate-blogs && npm run cache-github-stats && vite build && node scripts/generate-blog-pages.js && npm run generate-sitemap
scripts.validate:
npm run build && echo '
✅ Validation passed! Safe to push.
'
scripts.setup: npm run generate-icons && npm run generate-resume
